summary: Petrobras, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Petrobras Global Finance B.V., filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption price for its 7.375% Global Notes due 2027. The redemption date is June 26, 2026. The aggregate principal amount to be redeemed is US$670,009,000. The redemption price per US$1,000 principal is US$1,016.037154, including a make-whole premium of US$16.037154 per US$1,000. Accrued interest from January 17, 2026 to the redemption date is US$32.572917 per US$1,000. The total payment to holders is approximately US$680,754,037.51. The trustee will distribute funds via DTC. Funding comes from available cash. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation.
